notes:
- Company: mid-market B2B SaaS (search + knowledge discovery for vertical marketplaces).
- Primary buyer: Head of Product (Elena Morales); technical champion: Staff ML Engineer (Samir Patel).
- Current infra: multi-cloud (GCP primary), planning to colocate sensitive EU indexes in a separate VPC.
- Use case detail: they run a two-stage search stack (BM25 -> candidate generation -> rerank). Want Redwood rerank endpoint to replace in-house neural reranker for latency/cost savings.
- Latency/throughput targets: p95 latency <= 120ms for rerank (candidate size 40), sustained 400 qps during peak; flexible for batch offline scoring.
- Quality needs: A/B test improvement on NDCG@10; ability to run offline evals on labeled eval sets and surface per-query regressions.
- Model preferences: prefer open LLM variants; willing to test quantized variants. Need support for deterministic rerank scoring and stable seeds for reproducible offline eval.
- Security: SOC2 required; must support SSO + SCIM; logs retention policy on by default but need option to redact PII; KMS integration required for key management.
- Cost sensitivity: Mid-market budget but ROI-driven; projected ARR if successful = $60k-150k. Looking for clear per-token and per-eval pricing; interested in Optimize suggestions to reduce unit cost.
- Quote from Elena on 2026-02-25 demo: "If we can get consistent NDCG uplift at half our current cost per 1k reranks, this is a go."
- Demo notes: Hosted API demo (2026-02-10) showed streaming + function-calling irrelevant for rerank; main interest was rerank endpoint and offline scoring API.
- Security review: submitted SOC2 questionnaire (link above), waiting on follow-up about log residency and retention windows.
- POC scope proposed: week 0 kick-off, week 1 data ingestion + offline eval baseline, week 2 model tune + rerank endpoint alpha, week 3 live A/B test on 10% traffic, week 4 report + pricing review.
- Internal decision process: Product approves technical POC; Finance requires a pricing proposal for Dedicated if throughput > 200 qps. IT/Security will sign off on VPC network config.
- Selling motions tried: self-serve onboarding for initial eval (used free credits), one AE demo, one technical deep-dive with SE.
- Competitive notes: they benchmarked OpenAI embeddings + custom ranker; main concerns were vendor lock and cost at scale.
- Action items for AE/SE: prepare Dedicated pricing scenario for 400 qps, compile quantization / model-size tradeoffs, provide sample eval script (offline scoring reproducibility).
